d: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

When the victim of a violent crime is a member of law enforcement, the job of investigating becomes personal.  At a United States border crossing, armed fugitives kidnapped a customs' inspector then vanished.

t: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
d: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.
Too often, convicted felons learn new techniques and find new partners in prison.  In 1982, a group of former inmates began a spree of kidnapping and robbery.
When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal.  When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted.  The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.

On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.
In the 1990s, neighborhoods in Detroit were terrorized by a gang of robbers.  Impersonating police officers, they invaded over 100 homes robbing, raping and torturing their victims.
Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.
In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.
Paul Maguire (Nicolas Cage) har blivit laglydig och lämnat sitt kriminella liv. Men hans förflutna kommer snart ikapp honom då den ryska maffian kidnappar hans dotter.

Miguel och Sarah är nygifta och helt kär i varandra men de kämpar för att odla sin lilla blygsamma bit mark i New Mexico. Men en mycket större kamp väntar, för den makt hungriga markägaren och stadspredikanten Josiah kommer att ha fingrarna i sin egendom.
Mot slutet av Koreakriget träffas en skör vapenvila, men striderna fortsätter i öst. Målet är att ta kontroll över en strategisk punkt för att fastställa gränsen mellan de två länderna.
En pensionerad polis och hans småkriminelle bror köper en tävlingshäst, men deras planer på enkla pengar kompliceras när en gängkriminell stjäl hästen. Med Kiefer Sutherland och Anthony LaPaglia.
